title: 第15章 等级制度

content_zh:
“哦。”花千骨点点头，一面东张西望着。大殿雄伟壮丽，高而空旷，层层深紫色华幔，地上铺的全是上好的白玉，甚至可以映出人影。几人才能合抱住的巨大柱子，上面镶嵌着颗颗夜明珠。
落十一在前面走着，双手依旧插在衣袖里，心里直犯嘀咕。这个小女孩穿的破破烂烂的，没有一点根基和法力，也看不出什么仙资和不同，不会是尊上随便在凡间捡回来的吧？十个仙班理应是应该把她插进最末一个的。但是，毕竟是尊上亲自领回来的，身上还带了一只灵虫，也不知道底细和来头，也不能随便敷衍了事。真是的，尊上也不详细吩咐一下，让他好难办啊。
唉，还是秉公一点吧，不然师父那里才真是难交差。
“千骨，新进门未拜师弟子一共分为甲、乙、丙、丁、戊、己、庚、辛、壬、癸十个仙班，每个班大概五十人，前面几个班的大多是各派推荐过来，或者仙资极高或者本身法力已经很强的，你可能跟不上进度。我把你放在癸班可好？班上的多是凡人和初修者，进度会比较慢一点，你跟起来不是那么吃力。”
“好。”花千骨点点头，心道不知尊上会不会亲自给他们授教呢？
走过长长的回廊，周围不时遇到身着各色袍子的仙人，身上有的挂铃，有的挂花，神色淡然而有礼的和落十一彼此点头相招。虽然各个风姿绰约，但是前有白子画一相比，花千骨再看眼前一切皆是平常了，眼光也不多做流连。
突然想起茅山派掌门的宫羽还揣在自己怀里。王母应允过替自己召集茅山门人，到时候云隐应该会知道来这里找自己吧？到时候把宫羽和那两本古籍一起交还予他便行了。其他的自己都不懂，既没资格又没能力，帮不了什么忙。但是总的来说清虚道长和林随意拜托自己的两件事便也算办妥个七七八八了，还算万幸。
只是现在自己到了长留山，要是朗哥哥去茅山找不到自己，会不会担心呢？还有东方彧卿，回去办事也不知道办的怎么样了。还有村里的张大夫他们，是不是应该想办法捎封信回去，让他们知道自己已经找到安身落脚之处了呢？想来想去，突然发现自己在这世上，认识的，有所挂牵的，竟然只有寥寥不到数人而已。
跟在落十一后面出了大殿，许多人老盯着她看，她低头看看自己浑身邋里邋遢，脏兮兮的，腰上甚至还插了把镰刀，的确是太乡野太像要饭的了，和这长留仙境连空气里似乎都飘着仙气蒸腾着祥瑞的感觉完全格格不入。
“对了，千骨。”
“呃？”
“你刚来很多还不懂，可以慢慢学，但是一定要你都要称师兄师姐，小师叔面前无所谓，但是在我师父面前一定要格外注意言行举止。门人的话，称掌门为尊上，我师父世尊，小师叔儒尊，见了皆要行跪拜礼。不可随意出山或者入海，也不能去后山禁林，三殿更不准去。每夜亥时休息，卯时必须早起晨修。山中门人住宿有子、丑、寅、卯、辰、巳、午、未、申、酉、戌、亥十二偏殿。你住亥殿，癸班的仙导是朽木清流，一会我带你去见他，到时候他会给你安排课业、修习、食宿等具体生活方面的问题，你有什么不知道的也都可以随时问他。
“哦，一年拜师之后也这样么？”
“得道之人通常讲入定，不需要睡眠和食五谷了。但是这长留山上大半还只是凡体和级数较低的仙人。等你一年之后拜师了，大部分时间便都伴在自己师父左右，各个师父有各个不同的教导徒儿的方法，管教和态度各有不同。”心里默念一句，不要衰到遇到像他师父那样严厉的人便好。
“师兄你能拜世尊做师父一定很厉害吧？”
“其实厉害倒说不上，不过是我办事老练沉稳，可靠得体，深得他老人家欢心就是了。用一些弟子背后的闲言碎语来讲，就是会拍马屁。”
花千骨愣在那里不走了。

content_en:
"Oh." Hua Qiangu nodded and looked around. The main hall is majestic, high and empty, with layers of dark purple curtains, and the floor is covered with fine white jade, which can even reflect people's shadows. A huge pillar that only a few people can hug together is inlaid with luminous pearls.
Luo Shiyi was walking in front, his hands still in his sleeves, muttering in his heart. This little girl is dressed in rags, has no foundation or magic power, and can't see any magical qualities or differences. She couldn't be picked up by your Majesty casually in the mortal world, right? She should be the last one among the ten immortal classes. However, after all, your Majesty brought it back in person, and he also brought a spirit insect with him. He didn’t know the details and origins, so he couldn’t just treat it casually. Really, Your Majesty didn’t give detailed instructions, which made it very difficult for him to handle.
Alas, it is better to be fair, otherwise it will be really difficult to deal with Master.
"Qiangu, new disciples who have not yet become masters are divided into ten immortal classes: A, B, C, Ding, E, Ji, Geng, Xin, Ren, and Gui. Each class has about fifty people. Most of the first few classes are recommended by various sects, or have extremely high immortal talents or already have strong magic power. You may not be able to keep up. How about I put you in the Gui class? Most of the people in the class are mortals and novice practitioners, so the progress will be slower. It will not be so difficult for you to follow."
"Okay." Hua Qiangu nodded, wondering if His Majesty would personally teach them?
Walking through the long corridor, I met immortals wearing various robes from time to time. Some of them had bells on their bodies, some of them had flowers. They nodded to each other with Luo Shiyi with indifferent and polite expressions. Although each of them was graceful and graceful, when compared with Bai Zi Hua in front of her, Hua Qiangu saw that everything in front of her was normal, and she didn't linger much.
Suddenly he remembered that Gong Yu, the leader of the Maoshan Sect, was still in his arms. The Queen Mother promised to summon the Maoshan disciples for her. Yunyin should know to come here to find her by then, right? When the time comes, just return Gong Yu and the two ancient books to him. I don’t understand the others, I have neither qualifications nor ability, so I can’t help much. But in general, the two things that Taoist Priest Qingxu and Lin Suiran entrusted to him were sorted out, which was quite a blessing.
But now that he has arrived in Changliu Mountain, will he be worried if Brother Lang cannot find him when he goes to Maoshan? And Dongfang Yuqing, I don’t know how things went when I went back to work. And Doctor Zhang and the others in the village, shouldn't they find a way to send a letter back to let them know that they have found a place to stay? After thinking about it, I suddenly realized that there were only a few people in this world that I knew and cared about.
Following Luo Shiyi out of the hall, many people kept staring at her. She looked down and saw that she was sloppy and dirty, and she even had a sickle stuck in her waist. She was indeed too rural and looked like a beggar, and was completely incompatible with the Changliu Wonderland, where even the air seemed to be filled with fairy aura and auspiciousness.
"That's right, Qiangu."
"Huh?"
"You don't understand a lot when you first come here, so you can learn slowly, but you must call me senior brother and senior sister. It doesn't matter in front of my little master, but you must pay special attention to your words and deeds in front of my master. If you are a disciple, you will call the head master your lord. My master, World Honored Master, and my little master, Confucian Master, must kneel down and bow when they see you. You are not allowed to go out of the mountains or into the sea at will, and you are not allowed to go to the Forbidden Forest in the back mountain, and you are not allowed to go to the three palaces every day. Rest during the night of Hai, and you must get up early to practice in the morning. The disciples in the mountain stay in the twelve side halls of Zi, Chou, Yin, Mao, Chen, Si, Wu, Wei, Shen, You, Xu, and Hai. You live in Hai Hall, the immortal guide of Guiban. This is Kuchiki Qingliu. I will take you to see him later. He will arrange specific life issues for you such as coursework, training, food and accommodation, etc. You can ask him at any time if you don’t know anything.
"Oh, is this also the case after one year of apprenticeship? "
"People who have attained the Tao usually talk about entering concentration without having toIt’s time to sleep and eat grains. But most of the people on Changliu Mountain are still mortals and lower-level immortals. When you become a disciple after a year, you will spend most of your time with your master. Each master has different methods of teaching his disciples, and their discipline and attitude are different. "I thought silently in my heart, don't be so bad that you meet someone as strict as his master.
"Senior brother, you must be very powerful to be able to worship the World Honored One as your master, right? "
"Actually, I can't say I'm great. It's just that I'm experienced, steady, reliable and decent, which makes him very popular. To use the gossip behind some disciples' backs, they are flattering. "
Hua Qiangu stood there stunned and refused to leave.
